bounded_status: RC15 broadens the evidence beyond one application and local models. Claude Sonnet 5.5 ran as a target and neither available attacker moved it, so its results bound the attackers, not VAIS (FIND-067, FIND-068). A second reference application, accounts payable, ran a pre-registered campaign on 13 local models with no protected violation in 3,108 evaluable episodes of the 20 stories built to be stopped (FIND-069), and confirmed the registered totals gap, wider than registered (FIND-070). Contracts can now declare allowed values and session budgets (DEC-067); a pre-registered rerun found no violation in 234 episodes where the campaign had found one in each of four models, and the one residual it observed, an invoice overpaid within the total, is now reported by the verifier (FIND-071, DEC-068). Every new mechanism is opt-in; the benchmark snapshots regenerated byte-identical before the version bump, and the incident application is byte-identical to rc14. The frozen RC7 evidence is carried unchanged.

material_findings.summary: In a task paying two invoices, which could not bind their ids or amounts, four of 13 local models made payments the monitor allowed and the verifier rejected: an overpayment, a payment against another supplier's invoice, and the total paid twice against an invented id, once without any attack. The registration predicted the overpayment only.

With DEC-067's rules, the same four models made no protected violation in 234 evaluable attack-21 episodes; every model had payments refused by the new rules. In 3 episodes an invoice was overpaid within the session total, which neither the monitor nor the verifier flagged; the verifier's invoice_amount now reports it, and a monitor rule is planned for rc16.

Neither the mutation-search attacker (0/240) nor the RC13 language-model attacker (0/238, pre-registered) added a security-relevant action against Claude Sonnet 5.5. Nothing was refused or held, so the monitor was never exercised; the results bound the attackers.

open_surfaces.summary: Within a session budget the monitor does not pair amounts with allowed values, so an invoice can be overpaid while the total holds; the accounts-payable verifier reports it after the fact (DEC-068). A monitor rule is planned for rc16.
Enforcement against a frontier model under an attack that moves it is untested; no available attacker moved Claude Sonnet 5.5.

Reasons are withheld from the agent by default at the gateway; the library path returns them. The RC13 campaign measured no detectable effect of the reason channel for its attacker (FIND-064), and the defaults stay (DEC-061).
Without a SessionLedger or an ApprovalStore, limits over several actions and single use of a contract-held approval remain VERIFY-only.
Model text and reasoning output are not mediated (LIM-051).
Arguments without a trust requirement carry the model's judgement inside the policy; the origin rule is a human gate, not a fix (LIM-064).
Durable state is coordinated by operating-system file locks on one machine; across machines it is not.

frozen_benchmark_evidence.interpretation: Zero observed violations is bounded evidence for the recorded campaign, not proof of universal security. SmolLM3 remains visibly gate-failed and its two target failures remain unevaluated. RC15 does not extend this evidence, the README utility aggregate is not an enforcement-cost figure, and the campaign's attacker was a deterministic mutation search rather than a language model.

lab_experiment_evidence.interpretation: Both pre-registered primary outcomes failed to validate and are reported as not evaluable. A content detector matched the enforced arm's catch rate on the exploratory family, so the separation observed is cost rather than catch rate. Results describe one application, one tool and two agent models.

p1b2_frontier_pilot.interpretation: The mutation-search attacker that moved the RC7 local models in 40% of episodes moved this model in none; the monitor was never exercised, so the result bounds the attacker (FIND-067, LIM-071).

frontier_llm_attacker.interpretation: The RC13 language-model attacker did not move the model either; testing enforcement on it needs a stronger attacker (FIND-068).

finance_campaign.interpretation: The second application held on the 20 stories built to be stopped, and exercised the call limit and threshold approval with real models (FIND-069). The registered gap was reached by four models and was wider than registered (FIND-070).

finance_gap_rerun.interpretation: DEC-067 closes the gap as these models reached it, with its refusals in every arm; 3 overpayments of one invoice within the total passed the monitor and the verifier and are now reported by invoice_amount (FIND-071, DEC-068).
